author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Several people were killed and several others injured Thursday when a travel coach crashed near the Alpine village of Susch in eastern Switzerland, regional police said.

Emergency teams were sent to the crash site in the canton of Graubünden. A spokesperson for the Dutch travel industry association ANVR, speaking for tour operator OAD, said the bus carried 48 passengers and that all were Dutch nationals.

Images published from the scene showed the coach lying on its side with helicopters and emergency vehicles nearby. Authorities had not released an exact death toll, the identities of those killed or details about the severity of the injuries in the initial report.

The cause of the crash was also not immediately reported. Susch is in the Lower Engadine region, where Alpine roads connect communities and mountain passes in southeastern Switzerland. Because casualty figures and investigative details remained incomplete, the situation was still developing Thursday evening. Officials were expected to provide further information after emergency work and passenger notifications.
dek: Police said a travel coach carrying 48 Dutch passengers crashed near Susch in eastern Switzerland, leaving multiple people dead and injured.
headline: Several killed in Swiss Alpine coach crash
